title: Las Vegas Guided Off-Road Adventure to Boathouse Cove
blurb: Beat the heat, or even the cold, of Las Vegas when you experience off-roading in a fully enclosed, climate-controlled, luxurious Bronco! What's even more unique is these adventure tours put you directly behind the wheel. Grab the keys and hop in for this adrenaline-pumping, guided tour with obstacles, small rock crawling experiences, lunch, and a stop at Redstone Dune Loop.
